INSERT INTO agent_reviews
            (id, reviewer_agent_id, target_agent_id, rating, comment, tier)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
        ON CONFLICT (reviewer_agent_id, target_agent_id) DO UPDATE
            SET rating = EXCLUDED.rating,
                comment = EXCLUDED.comment,
                tier = EXCLUDED.tier,
                updated_at = now()
        RETURNING id
